# relay driver (e2e bench brief)

A relay driver board. A 3.3 V logic signal from a host arrives on a 0.1 inch
header, which also carries 5 V and ground. It switches a 5 V relay coil through
a transistor, with the flyback protection the coil needs. The relay's common,
normally-open and normally-closed contacts go out on a screw terminal.
